prompts.harbor:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production animation atlas for the original pixel RPG Chronoforge: The Unwritten Hour.
Create a new 1536 by 1536 PNG with actual transparent alpha, exactly SIX equal columns and SIX equal rows, 36 uniform 256 by 256 cells. No visible grid or separators. Each row is ONE different character, repeated in SIX genuinely distinct animation poses across that row. This sheet will be sliced at exact sixths; nothing may cross a cell boundary.
Style: beautifully hand-pixeled detailed 2D JRPG sprites, late 16-bit / early 32-bit character art with expressive faces, small precise pixel clusters, dark plum outlines, shaded fabric folds, leather and metal highlights. Full body, roughly FOUR HEADS tall; the same attractive illustrated pixel-art level of finish as a magenta-haired cyan-jacket swordswoman, violet-hooded void mage and gold-armored goggled sentinel. These are supporting characters, not those three heroes. Natural compact adult proportions, not giant-headed chibi dolls, not vector art, not smooth cartoon painting, not tiny abstract stick people. Unlit transparent background, no environment, no text, no names, no watermark, no baked shadow.
Layout invariant: in EVERY 256×256 cell, the actor is centered at x=128 and the soles of both boots sit on y=230; top of head approximately y=35. Body, costume and held props fully contained within x=58..198. All six frames keep identical scale, costume, facial identity and planted feet, facing the viewer with a slight three-quarter turn to the right.
Frame order left-to-right in EVERY row: 1 relaxed neutral idle; 2 breathing in with chest and shoulders subtly rising; 3 a blink and gentle head inclination; 4 a small expressive hand or held-object gesture; 5 gesture settling with a different arm silhouette; 6 returning toward neutral with relaxed shoulders. These must be authored distinct poses, not six identical copies and not translations or rotations of a static picture.
Rows from TOP to BOTTOM (never reorder):
ROW 1: Lio, young adult ferry mechanic: warm copper work jacket and brass buttons, dark auburn hair under a brown work cap, round cyan-lensed goggles pushed onto cap, leather apron, dark trousers, sturdy boots, small silver wrench. Friendly earnest face; a blue ferry-ribbon tied at wrist.
ROW 2: Mara, kindly middle-aged harbor innkeeper: dark brown hair in a practical bun, warm russet dress, cream apron, rose headscarf ribbon, leather slippers, a small folded towel. Warm and welcoming, a visibly different face/body from Lio.
ROW 3: Pip, compact energetic harbor provisioner: chestnut short hair, dusty violet short coat over cream shop apron, ochre belt-pouch, dark trousers, bright alert eyes; holding a small copper coin purse.
ROW 4: Brann, broad sturdy harbor blacksmith: brown hair and short brown beard, copper-brown work shirt, thick leather apron, brass-rimmed pale-cyan safety goggles above eyes, heavy gloves at belt, dark boots; a short blacksmith hammer.
ROW 5: Edda, older harbor archivist: swept chestnut hair streaked silver, fine round spectacles, layered dusty-violet robe and pale lavender shawl, warm parchment trim, elegant dark shoes; holding a closed violet-bound book.
ROW 6: Tavi, young forest courier: dark tousled brown hair, copper-orange short travel coat, green scarf, sturdy calf boots and a worn tan cross-body mail satchel visibly stuffed with cream envelopes. Lively determined face and small messenger gestures.

prompts.cache: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: two-state game pickup sprite atlas. Create a NEW 1024 by 512 pixel transparent PNG with exactly TWO equal square 512x512 cells side by side. The left cell is a CLOSED salvage chest, the right cell is the SAME salvage chest OPEN with its lid lifted. Background must have genuine transparent alpha; no visible grid, labels, text, caption, shadow or scenery. Beautiful crisp 16-bit/32-bit JRPG pixel art, precise clustered shading and dark plum outlines matching a detailed four-head-tall pixel RPG cast. Small weathered honey-brown wooden salvage trunk with brass corner protectors, two brass lid straps, a central brass clasp with a tiny muted cyan indicator, dark iron hinges. The open interior is empty dark plum wood, no coins spilling out. Same chest body, perspective, color and proportions in both cells; three-quarter front view with slight visible top and right side. Center the chest bodies at x=256 and x=768 respectively, bottom baseline y=418 in both cells. The closed chest occupies roughly 320x220 pixels; the opened lid makes the right chest taller, roughly320x310 pixels. Keep wide fully transparent margins. Draw as deliberately enlarged pixel art with hard small pixel clusters; no smooth 3D render, no blurry brush strokes, no photorealism.
